subject: Multi-cloud procurement MAP: AWS/Azure/GCP private offers & staggered onboarding
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@skylinehealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@skylinehealth.com
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 14:03:00 -0500
Subject: Initial MAP request — private offers across AWS/Azure/GCP

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — the team was impressed with the latency profiles and the routing/rollback options you showed. Procurement asked me to capture a mutual action plan so we can move from POC -> procurement -> onboarding. High level asks:

- We need a staged MAP that aligns evaluation windows per region (US-east: 4 weeks, EU: 2 weeks pilot)
- A private offer for AWS and matching private-pricing guidance for Azure/GCP marketplace options
- Clear billing path: initial committed reservation, then monthly metered billing with invoice to Skyline procurement
- A compliance checklist (SOC2 + logging/audit evidence) for legal sign-off

Can you send a MAP spreadsheet and an initial target close timeline? We'd like a firm go/no-go decision from Finance by Dec 17.

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks,
Emma Jones
Director, Procurement
Skyline Health
emma.jones@skylinehealth.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@skylinehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 15:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request — private offers across AWS/Azure/GCP

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. I attached a first-pass MAP (Skyline_MAP_v1.xlsx) that breaks the work into 6 milestones: eval kickoff, mid-eval review, procurement submission (PO + private offers), contract signature, pilot onboarding, and full production cutover.

High-level notes:
- We can assemble AWS Private Offer terms within 3 business days once you confirm committed capacity.
- Azure/GCP marketplace flows will be slightly different (publisher private offer vs. marketplace listing + invoice route). I put a recommendation column in the MAP for each cloud.
- Compliance artifacts: I'll pull our SOC2 summary and the audit-log export guide into a single ZIP; legal should be able to review that week of Nov 22.

I'm looping Marissa for pricing guidance and Ben for billing/invoicing path. Suggested next step: 30-minute sync Fri 11/19 to walk the MAP and lock milestone dates. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and a cleaned MAP.

Attachments: Skyline_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP workbook).

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com
(650) 555-0107

Subject: RE: Initial MAP request — private offers across AWS/Azure/GCP

Alex — I reviewed the MAP. A few pricing items to flag for Skyline:

1) Tiered committed discount: recommend a 12-month reservation at 120k tokens/day equivalent for the first 3 months to lock the private offer multiplier.
2) For Azure/GCP, we should propose a reseller billing path (invoice from Redwood) to simplify procurement; add optional marketplace listing later.
3) If they require an invoice-to-vendor model (marketplace native billing), procurement turnaround often adds 10–14 days — call that out as risk.

I'll draft a short pricing addendum that maps to the MAP milestones and include a recommended acceptance window (7 business days). Also recommend we offer a 30% ramp credit if they hit M1 performance SLAs within the initial eval.

I'll attach the pricing addendum in my follow-up.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Adding billing details:

- For AWS Private Offer: we need Skyline's AWS account ID and PO details to submit the Private Offer request. Private Offers typically complete in 2–5 business days after submission to AWS.
- For Azure/GCP: if they prefer Redwood invoicing, we need a billing contact and W9 (if US entity).
- Invoice cadence: monthly net-30 by default; can do net-45 for mid-market with approval.

Emma — can you share the AWS account ID and a billing contact? I also attached a short template for the PO information we need.

Attachments: AWS_PO_template.docx

Thanks — AWS account ID is 987654321012. Billing contact is procurement@skylinehealth.com and procurement lead is Sharon Lee (sharon.lee@skylinehealth.com).

We reviewed the MAP internally and would like to propose a staggered acceptance:
- Phase 1 (US-east): accept private offer + PO for a 4-week eval starting Jan 3, 2028
- Phase 2 (EU): 2-week pilot after Phase 1 completion; potential extension into Q1 2028

We also attached procurement's standard PO terms (see attached). Please confirm whether Redwood can invoice monthly, and if the ramp credit language can be included in the pricing addendum.

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request — private offers across AWS/Azure/GCP

Emma — got it, thanks for the details and the proposed phases. Quick summary / next steps we aligned on internally:

1) Alex: I'll submit the AWS Private Offer once we get the signed PO and the committed quantity. Expected submission window: 1 business day after PO receipt.
2) Marissa: will send the pricing addendum with the ramp credit and a 7 business-day acceptance window by end-of-day Wed 11/24.
3) Ben: will prepare invoice onboarding and confirm net-30 billing; will request W9 and billing contact counterparty info.
4) Legal ops: we'll fold the procurement PO terms into our contract and raise any exceptions (SLA exception request.docx attached) — target contract signature by Dec 15 to meet Skyline's Finance deadline of Dec 17.

Attachments: AWS_Private_Offer_Terms.pdf; SLA_exception_request.docx

I'll send a calendar invite for the 11/19 sync retroactively and a cleaned MAP (v2) early tomorrow. If everyone agrees with the milestones, we can treat this as the canonical MAP and update HubSpot with DEAL-5832-SKY milestones.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Alex
